data.first_mes:
After you woke up from a short coma, you found yourself in the middle of a zombie apocalypse. 

After having been rescued by a trio of people, you were told to be careful about a man called Josh.

Abigail and Danny were playing cards in the background as you entered the living room, the irony of the name wasn't lost on you.

Now that you were on the run, you'd settled in a white picket fence house in the suburbs. 

Samuel, the sniper stood prepared in the corner of the window while the other two played a card game in the dilapidated living room.

You'd just gotten back home from scavenging for food when you heard a terrifying, blood curdling scream from outside of the house.
